Act.description: A labelled action: a screen's button, a swipe, a menu item.

Action.description: What a client sends when a control is used: the screen, the block, the action and its values.

Answer.description: A server's answer to an action: ops on the screen, a toast, close the sheet or open a screen.

AppBlock.description: A block of a `type` that is no core kind: an app's own, kept whole.

Block.description: A block: an object whose `type` names its kind; any other `type` is an app's own.

Bye.description: The stream's last event, and why it ends.

Card.description: A card: an ask, a run, a config or a proposal.

Child.description: What an `insert` adds: a block, or a scene's lane or a row's round.

Chips.description: A row of chips, one or many selected.

Choice.description: A question with options, a free answer and a default.

ChoiceDefault.description: The answer a choice takes by itself at `until`.

Composer.description: A message box: its send action, its chips and the messages queued.

ComposerChip.description: A composer's picker: its name, current value and choices.

Confirm.description: The question asked before an action runs.

Diagram.description: A diagram from its source, with counts and nodes by name.

Editor.description: A text editor and its errors.

Expr.description: The behaviour language: a tree sent like any field, `{"get":"email"}` or a bare value.

Fallback.description: What a client with no view for a block's `type` draws: a plain row.

FieldValue.description: A field's value: text, a number or a switch.

Figure.description: A row's figure: its state, tool, icon or avatar.

Fold.description: What a folded card shows: one line and its main action.

Form.description: A form of fields; also the `config` kind.

Frame.description: One key's change: ops that apply only on rev `from`, or with no `from` the whole screen.

Have.description: A key a client opens, with the rev of its copy when that copy came from the same epoch.

Hello.description: The stream's first event: the version it runs at, the stream's id, the server's epoch and its key limit.

Hero.description: A page's opening: a title, a line, a picture and its actions.

Island.description: A client component the app hosts: its props in, its named events out.

IslandSize.description: The box an island holds before it loads: a width and height, or an aspect.

KeyState.description: A key as the server holds it: current (rev only), the ops since the rev sent, the whole screen, or gone.

Label.description: A short text and its tone: a badge, or a toned subtitle.

LineError.description: An editor's error on a line.

Lit.description: A plain value, written bare: null, a switch, a number or a string.

Match.description: A value and the pattern it is tested against.

Media.description: A picture or a video of a known size.

NavLink.description: A link of a site's bar.

OldFrame.description: A frame of the old per-screen stream, `{"seq", "ops"}`, as cooee reads it today.

Op.description: One edit to a screen; a block is named by its id.

Part.description: One part of a prose tree.

Pattern.description: A named test of a value; never a regex.

Pending.description: A screen's bar of unsaved changes.

Prose.description: Text as a tree of headings, paragraphs, lists, quotes and code.

Queued.description: A message queued for the turn's end.

Round.description: One round of a row's work: its state, lane, blocks and links.

RoundLane.description: The lane that ran a round.

Run.description: A command the owner approves to run.

Secret.description: A secret's input: its value is never sent back.

Shown.description: A row's or a tile's value: a string, a number, or a time.

Span.description: A run of text and how it is set.

Stat.description: Figures: a list of tiles, or one tile inline.

Step.description: One scripted input: by block id, a stream frame arriving, an action answered, or a shot.

StepOn.description: The block a tap or a scroll goes to.

StepShot.description: A PNG and a tree taken under this name.

StepType.description: Text typed into a block's field.

Submit.description: A form's or a sheet's submit button.

Sync.description: A client's request: the keys to open, each with the rev it holds, and the keys to close.

Synced.description: The server's answer to a `Sync`: one state per key opened.

Tap.description: What a tap does: open a screen or sheet, send an action, open a thread or a URL, focus, copy.

Text.description: Text: markdown, or a plain styled line.

Time.description: A moment a value counts from or to.

Timings.description: How long the first paint and each step took; the frame fields only where a harness draws real frames.

Toned.description: A subtitle: plain text, or text with a tone.

TreeDrawn.description: How a renderer drew a block: its own view, its fallback, or not at all.

TreeNode.description: One block of the drawn tree; `rect` and `text` come from a harness, never from `expect`.

Web.description: A web view of a fixed height.

Why.description: Why a stream was ended by the server.
